summary: Compassionate appointment eligibility; financial distress standard; age relaxation under 1993 scheme; terminal benefits/family pension not substitute for compassionate job; bank's refusal based on non-indigence improper; scheme object requires liberal interpretation; delay in appointment unjustified; compensation for inordinate delay upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Canara Bank v M Mahesh Kumar
State Bank of India v Somveer Singh
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court directions upheld; respondent entitled to appointment in sub-staff cadre with Rs. 5 lakh compensation.
